name: Local Deals
tagline: Daily local marketplace deals that it will negotiate for you

source.excerpt: Shared as a local deal scout that also handles the haggling.

body:
## What it does

Scouts Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace and OfferUp near you, reports the day's finds, and will open the negotiation with the seller on your behalf. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @brandon_galang shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
